entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Block collection expression spreads in catch filters #80331
  • "Go to Definition" sometimes opens plain text disassembly with no syntax highlighting #80329
  • Pattern matching against "interface or null" #80326
  • Syntax node actions triggered twice inside c# 14 extension declaration #80319
  • Remove dependency on Remote layer from TestComposition/ExportProviderCache #80316

Closed

  • Inexplicable CS8978 'T' cannot be made nullable #64431
    18.0
  • RuntimeAsync failed to run on aarch64 linux with dotnet10 rc #80313
    Next
  • Cover expression-bodied async methods with generic Task-like return values in implicit object creation analyzer #77670
    Backlog
  • Community contributors should use the `community` branch to develop using Visual Studio 17.14 #79948
  • Roslyn Language crashes when deleting last line in some IDEs #80119
    Backlog
  • Code completion suggests class name instead of local #38293
    Backlog
  • Intellisense override helper shows proper use of alias but the resulting code is missing it and invalid #42437
    Backlog
  • When the warning is long I can't see the end of it in the bottom bar of Visual Studio #77497
  • Doesn't navigate to function definitions, it decompiles code instead #77435
    Backlog
  • Calc Codemetrics does not works with c# / maui project. #77377
    Backlog
  • how can i use generated class as SyntaxProvider input? #77795
    Backlog
  • Double-clicking C# inline hints in order inserts their texts in wrong positions #77777
  • Remove and Sort Usings for entire project or solution #74523
    Backlog
  • Completion inside `with` expression initializers still treats required members specially #80192
    Backlog
  • Type-parameter signature help misleading with generic extension methods on generic types. #80233
    Backlog
  • Blurry text above LightBulb preview #80181
  • Wrong IDE0055 in combination with CRLF, XML comment and preprocessor directive #73122
    Backlog
  • Intellisense C# nameof() suggestions don't work inside object initializer #80258
    Backlog
  • CS8620 nullability issue for modern extension method parameters #80320
  • CS9282: This member is not allowed in an extension block #80312
  • Compiler should be a bit more lenient with inferring collection types for inlined collection initializers. #80306
  • Assert fails in `NullableWalker.AsMemberOfType` #80255
    Next

Created

  • Only restore based on assets file changes if the actual content changed #80341
    Area-IDE, VSCode

  • Switch ExpressionBodyDiagnosticAnalyzer to use SemanticSpanAnalysis #80339

  • Block spreads in exception filters #80337
